items.title: Minimum Hybrid Kontrakt (MHK): En kombinasjon av Juridiske og Blockchain-baserte Smarte Kontrakter
items.title_en: The Minimum Hybrid Contract (MHC): Combining Legal and Blockchain Smart Contracts
items.summary: Jørgen Svennevik Notland's master's thesis on the Minimum Hybrid Contract (MHC): a legal contract combined with a blockchain smart contract for transparent, immutable financial transactions. Supervisors named on the NTNU Open record are Røger Sørheim and Donn Morrison. The NTNU Open degree-type field says bachelor.

items.title: Blockchain enabled Trust & Transparency in supply chains
items.summary: Project thesis at the NTNU School of Entrepreneurship, with Anders Viet Hua, on whether blockchain can increase trust and transparency in supply chains. ResearchGate dates the record 2017; a 2016 date also appears in another catalogue. It is not in NTNU Open.
